messages.subject: Re: Heywood case

Angel--
     faildmonthw1 is a dependent variable in this model, so what lavaan reports is its residual variance. That can be negative for many reasons, including random sampling variance, especially if the negative value is small. You could try constraining that residual variance to be non-negative, and see what that costs you in terms of fit.
--Ed Rigdon
